principles: 3-2-1: at least three copies, two media/accounts, one offsite
all backups are client-side encrypted before offsite replication
restore drills use a fresh isolated target and never a production endpoint
secrets are referenced by identifier only in evidence

offsite.target: operator-controlled S3-compatible bucket in an account distinct from Cloudflare and the PostgreSQL host
offsite.encryption: age encryption using OFFSITE_BACKUP_AGE_RECIPIENT plus provider encryption at rest
offsite.integrity: SHA-256 manifest signed/verified before retention pruning

assets.frequency: nightly export; Finance every 4h during active pilot
assets.restore: export -> checksum -> fresh local/scratch D1 -> migrations -> table-count and domain smoke

assets.rpo: 1h for operational PostgreSQL; 24h for CRM schemas until WAL/archive is provisioned
assets.frequency: daily encrypted logical dump; WAL/archive when provisioned
assets.primaryCopy: private native backup root on service host
assets.restore: pg_restore into a new scratch database with restricted role; compare schema, counts and domain smoke
assets.testFrequency: weekly for Orb; monthly for CRM

systems: operational R2 payloads and domain backup buckets
assets.frequency: daily inventory plus immutable object replication
assets.offsiteCopy: encrypted object copy outside Cloudflare account
assets.restore: download selected recovery point into isolated bucket/path; verify manifest checksums and read-only access

assets.retention: 90 daily manifests and last 12 release checkpoints
assets.restore: restore into a clean private runtime path; validate units/config syntax; secrets are rehydrated from secret manager rather than copied to Git

assets.frequency: daily; before destructive recovery or migration
assets.primaryCopy: native runtime backup and domain-owned stores
assets.restore: fresh state directory/database; verify hashes, workflow count and queue reconciliation before cutover
